يستشكلوا (form X)
# يَسْتَشْكِلُوا (yastaškilū) /jas.taʃ.ki.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# يُسْتَشْكَلُوا (yustaškalū) /jus.taʃ.ka.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
